name: HIP 21152

planets.name: B
planets.note: Substellar (brown dwarf) companion at semimajor axis 17.5(+7.2/-3.8) au, dynamical mass 27.8(+8.4/-5.4) M_Jup (mass ratio ~2%); spectrum consistent with L/T transition, best fit by an early T dwarf (T0+-1). First substellar companion directly imaged around a Sun-like star in the Hyades open cluster; host is an accelerating star per Hipparcos-Gaia astrometry. Independently identified by Bonavita et al. 2022 and Franson et al. 2022 (arXiv:2211.09840), who measure a dynamical mass of 24(+6/-4) M_Jup.
